# Premodel

> Premodel turns your remodel ideas into photorealistic Reveals of your actual home: three design directions, an optional VR walkthrough, and a Plan you can take to any builder. Serving the greater Seattle area (King and Snohomish counties, Washington, USA).

Premodel is the first hire for a home remodel. Before a homeowner commits to a designer, architect, or contractor, Premodel visits the home, listens, and produces photorealistic images of the homeowner's own rooms reimagined three different ways. From there, an optional Plan refines one direction into a build-ready design, with materials sourced at trade prices and up to three vetted builder bids. Everything is the homeowner's to keep, whichever builder they choose.

Legal name: West & Wells LLC, doing business as Premodel. Co-founded by Ashley Wells and Paige Shaw, each with 25+ years in design and technology and twelve remodels of their own homes between them.

## Services

- Reveal: photorealistic images of your room reimagined three different ways, based on a home visit. Delivered in as little as 2 days after the visit. Yours to keep, even if you don't hire Premodel. Additional directions available for a modest fee.
- Plan: a live video session to refine your favorite Reveal (or the best of all three) into one design. Includes a private project page for iterating on updated designs, a shopping list of every fixture and material with alternatives at different price points and trade discounts, and optional engagement of a vetted architect or designer with their cost included in the Plan price. New deliverables follow within 2 to 4 days of feedback.
- VR walkthrough: optional. Stand in your redesigned space at life size to test layout changes before they cost you.
- Builder bids: optional final step of a Plan. Up to three trusted local builders visit, bid, and you pick. Never a requirement.

Best suited to: kitchens, bathrooms, basements and ADUs, full-floor reconfigurations, and new-build interiors where the floor plan exists but the finishes and elevations are undecided.

## Service area

Greater Seattle, Washington: King County and Snohomish County (Seattle, Bellevue, Edmonds, Shoreline and surrounding cities). Expanding region by region; homeowners just outside the area are encouraged to ask.

## FAQ

- What should I expect from a Reveal? Photorealistic images of your room reimagined three different ways, based on what we hear at your home visit. They're a starting point: enough to know which direction excites you. A Plan is where we refine the details into a finished design.
- How long does this take? Reveals arrive in as little as 2 days after your home visit. New deliverables follow within 2 to 4 days of your feedback, so you lead the pace. A full timeline is proposed alongside your Reveal.
- How is Premodel different from a designer, architect, or design-build firm? Premodel is your first hire, and a lower-cost, lower-effort way to figure out what you want before you commit to anyone else. Premodel helps determine what your project actually needs, then assembles the team (designer, architect, contractor) as part of your Plan.
- Do I have to use your contractors? No. Your Reveal and your Plan are yours to keep and to take to whichever builder you choose. The three-bid intro is optional.

## Case studies

Full write-ups are on the homepage under "What Confidence Looks Like": https://premodel.design/#projects

- Anna G., master bath reconfigure, Edmonds: three layout options plus a VR walkthrough revealed that her preferred layout felt confining at real scale; the final design resolved storage, privacy and flow.
- Sasha A., full floor reconfigure, Edmonds: a preview before committing to a large construction budget; the contractor finished on time and on budget with nothing left to figure out.
- K.B., new-build kitchen, Seattle: VR surfaced cabinet height, island lighting and a subtle asymmetry that a floor plan would never have shown, all resolved before the contractor was ready to build.
- Jenn S., basement ADU, Bellevue: VR showed the planned U-shaped kitchen and angled shower entry felt cramped; she rebuilt the layout with the same confidence and no surprises.
